diagrams.notes: Bar chart of saves per UTC day, 19 October to 16 November. Pink for Lima-morning days, purple for the 00:41-07:37 UTC days, gray otherwise; values labelled on the five class days only; gridlines at 50; axis dates at 19 Oct, 2 Nov, 9 Nov and 16.
